lead: A fact `nvs-ir` and `nvs-runtime` both need lives in one of them and is held to the other by a test in `nvs-codegen`.
body: Neither crate names the other, so a shared constant has no crate both can see; `nvs-codegen` sees both, which is why `FN_ARITY`/`CALLABLE_ARITY_SLOT` are a pair with a codegen test between them and why the callable parameter-tag nibbles (`nvs_ir::lower::param_tag_nibble` writing, `nvs_runtime::Tag` reading) are held by `param_tag_nibbles_are_the_runtime_tag_bytes` in `crates/nvs-codegen/src/ty.rs`. A `pub fn` in `nvs-ir` plus a `#[test]` in `nvs-codegen` is the shape, not a new dependency edge.
